title: H-chain independent calibration / resource-decision validation
purpose: Evaluate finite-time CISD cheap calibration, incremental spectral information, frozen QPE decision value and acquisition cost within one H-chain protocol.
forbidden_claims: scaling exponent or statistical trend significance

blockers.issue: H6 population-sector Hamiltonian bytes and CISD state are not frozen; H2 individual state identity and sanitized adapters remain to be verified.
blockers.resolution: Separate truth-free input-preparation authorization, fixed cache provenance, then hash freeze. No current permission to generate H or H6 CISD.

blockers.issue: H2/H6 operational CISD leading fits are absent. Nine absolute candidate times and binary64 hex cannot all be populated without prohibited acquisition.
blockers.resolution: Review a bounded truth-free reference-preparation phase before candidate-plan freeze; never use historical exact-ground/D4 coefficients.

blockers.issue: Historical first-study acquisition constructs full PF matrices and loads exact-state fields. Fit/selection functions are reusable unchanged; a sanitized vector-only acquisition wrapper is not the identical historical runner.
blockers.resolution: Review acquisition-only adapter as an explicit implementation difference, retain leading_fit/grid/observable unchanged, freeze wrapper hash and counters.

blockers.issue: No measured combined H1 path exists. Fresh H1 replay in addition to standalone M1 would exceed the proposed global 60-action cap.
blockers.resolution: Review a single-acquisition schedule with conditional first access and later comparator completion; do not call the comparator runtime an independently measured H1 run.

blockers.issue: Nine-coordinate direct truth ceiling does not fix missing same-H exact-ground input or authorize its generation. H6 historical 200-dimensional restriction cannot substitute for the frozen 400-dimensional predictor sector.
blockers.resolution: Fix scorer-only same-H ground source, separate generation limit if needed, three-point continuation and gap validity before execution.

review_choices_required: Authorize bounded truth-free input/reference preparation separately or revise the requirement to freeze generated identities before all scientific preparation.
Approve and freeze acquisition adapter, shared H1 schedule and scorer-only ground preparation before any predictor/scorer run.
terminal_rule: Stop at protocolization review; no science even if design review passes.
